title: On $2$-stationarity of $\mathcal{P}_κλ$
abstract: The notion of $n$-stationary subsets of $\mathcal{P}_κλ$ for $n < ω$ were introduced and studied by Cody, Lambie-Hanson \& Zhang \cite{CLHZ} and Torres \cite{T}. They proved that if $κ$ is supercompact, then $\mathcal{P}_κλ$ is $n$-stationary in itself for all cardinals $λ\geq κ$ and all $n < ω$. In this paper we prove that strong compactness of $κ$ does not imply the $2$-stationarity of $\mathcal{P}_κλ$ for cardinals $λ> κ$. We also discuss Menas' Theorem for $1$-stationary and $2$-stationary subsets of $\mathcal{P}_κλ$.
